mechanism: A memory management primitive that uses {{compress}} to reduce the token footprint of a {{context}} while preserving critical {{state}}. It explicitly retains active {{constraint}}s and unresolved goals.
invariants: Reduces the {{context}}'s token footprint by at least `min_reduction`.
Retains every active {{constraint}} and every unresolved goal.
Re-evaluates which constraints are active and which goals unresolved on each pass.

parameters.name: min_reduction
parameters.description: Share of the token footprint a pass must remove to count as a compression.

failure_modes: Silent over-compression: a discarded {{constraint}} surfaces only when a later step violates it.
Stale activeness: a pass reuses an earlier pass's list of active constraints instead of recomputing it, so a lapsed constraint is preserved and a new one is dropped.
